question: Kanchan spends 60% of her income. If she saves ₹90,000, then her income (in ₹) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Income is always considered as 100%.

Savings % = 100% − Expenditure % = 100% − 60% = 40%

Given, 40% of Income = ₹90,000

Total Income (100%) = (90,000 ÷ 40) × 100 = 2,25,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,25,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expenditure = 60% of Income

Savings = ₹90,000

**Formula Used:**

Total Income = Expenditure + Savings
